description: Execute a single SQL statement against a Neon database.

branchId.description: Optional ID of the branch to run against; when omitted, the project's default branch is used.

databaseName.description: Optional name of the database to run against; when omitted, the project's default database is used.

projectId.description: ID of the Neon project that owns the database.

roleName.description: Optional name of the database role to run as; when omitted, the default role is used.

sql.description: The single SQL statement to execute against the Neon database.

name: run_sql
